game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ash ranger's power beats the shield shown by cinder bats.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: In Fire Shrine, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ash ranger's power beats the shield shown by cinder bats. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the power value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about power to power up the ash ranger and open the obsidian gate.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Fire Shrine.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
